prompts: Continue researching the TEP-9 outer-solar-system paper. Improve the analysis pipeline and raise the standard of evidence for TEP using only real published data; never fabricate.

Review the TEP-9 manuscript (site/components/*.html) with a referee's eye. Check that every number and claim in the text traces to a named field in results/*.json produced by the pipeline. Flag anything that does not trace, is overstated, or cannot be verified, and fix what is clearly wrong.

Look for bugs and methodological weaknesses in the pipeline (scripts/steps/, scripts/utils/). If any result looks weak or contradictory, treat it as a debugging signal first and investigate the root cause rather than weakening the claim. Fix confirmed problems.

Ensure the manuscript is consistent with the core TEP theory (../TEP, Paper 0) and the wider corpus (../TEP-*). Check that the scalar-field/lapse formalism, screening mechanism, notation, paper numbering, and interpretations follow correctly from the corpus framework; fix any mismatches.

Strengthen the plasma-wall channel: develop the Voyager 1/2 Plasma Wave Subsystem (PWS) evidence for the proper-time boundary. The PWS measures the electron plasma frequency f_p, a microscopic clock; test whether a lapse shift at the heliopause could produce the observed f_p jumps (Gurnett et al.) without a physical density discontinuity, including the anomalous non-rotation of the magnetic field across the boundary and Voyager 2's PLS in-situ densities. If raw PWS/PLS data are publicly retrievable, build a real pipeline step with provenance; if not, document published values explicitly as literature inputs — no fabricated data.

Test the heliospheric-interface geometry against the measured axis: evaluate whether the termination shock, heliopause, heliotail, and ISM-inflow geometry predicts or correlates with the resident axis (lambda~50 deg) and the 60 deg cap. Quantify what a density-triggered screening transition (the TEP-C0 mechanism) would imply for the boundary's location, orientation, and edge morphology, and whether the observed sector and sharp edge are consistent with a plasma-density-mediated interface versus a primordial defect.

Check the internal consistency of the three-clock story: resident orbital clocks (TNO alignment), macroscopic transiting clocks (the ~5 yr comet slip, fractional lapse contrast ~1e-3 to 1e-2), and microscopic clocks (electron plasma frequency) must all be manifestations of one boundary with a mutually compatible lapse amplitude. Verify the implied lapse contrast the Voyager frequency shift requires is consistent with the comet-inferred value, and reconcile or honestly report any tension.

Find weaknesses in the manuscript that could be overcome with better analysis of data already available — missing diagnostics, unaddressed systematics, robustness checks never run. Improve what you can and update the manuscript only where the analysis supports it.
Deep scan and fix all issues. Ensure strong evidence for TEP; treat weak results as debug signals, investigate root causes, and keep every manuscript number traceable to real pipeline outputs.
